gaps: Verify that Bidding Ends At equals the new start time plus exactly 1440 minutes.
Verify that the recreated event has the same product, delivery location, and participants as the old event.
Verify that the new event has a new RFX/stage code while the old event remains unchanged.

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ summary instead of searching the events list.
Enable the required eRFX project capability for the recreate flow.
Open the Recreate Order dialog from the RFQ stage settings.
Confirm that the Recreate Order dialog opened.
Verify that the event end-time duration picker offers the required 24 Hrs option.
Confirm the selected duration is shown in the dialog.
Confirm the evaluation duration remains 30 Mins.
Confirm the scheduling choice is present and can remain unset.
Submit the recreate order using the selected duration.
Confirm that creation navigated to the newly opened event page.
Confirm the new event page displays its bidding end-time field.
Ensure the recreate operation completed without an application error.
